And when the affix घञ् and अप् follow घसॢ is the substitute of अद्।

Terms: आर्धधातुक-substitutes

The affix ञ added to a noun of action ending in the affix घञ् denotes an action occurring in that.

Terms: ञ

The penultimate nasal of रञ्ज् is elided before घञ् when the word formed with it expresses a state or an instrument.

Terms: Nasal Elision
